## Release Notes

### Protocol & SPI Enhancements
- **#47** — Typed-dynamic pattern for handler protocols (OMN-710): `Mapping[str, JsonValue]` for open payloads, `TypedDict` for known structures, policy docstrings, constraints (max_keys=100, max_depth=5).
- **#69** — ProtocolEventPublisher semantics and policy codified (OMN-1615): topic override, partition_key handling, 18 unit tests.
- **#51** — ProtocolHandlerContract interface added (OMN-1164): handler_id, version, descriptor, capabilities, execution constraints, validate/to_yaml/from_yaml.

### Core Runtime Fixes
- **#1717** — occ-preflight accepts dependency-pin-only outcome (OMN-18848): reads producer outcome, avoids 1500s poll and `stamp_absent` failure.
- **#1655** — Def-B single-emit terminal recognized as this run's own (OMN-17980): fixes `_expected_correlation_id`/`_terminal_correlation_matches` for envelope-less handlers.
- **#1590** — OCC repo matched exactly, not by suffix (OMN-16353): prevents misclassification of same-named repos under different orgs.
- **#1462** — No-hardcoded-ip check scans multiple roots (OMN-14712): adds `scripts/` and `tests/` to `--root`, closes false-negative gap.
- **#1252** — Bump to v0.45.0 for envelope-dedup pin propagation (OMN-13200): breaking deletion of `ModelOnexEnvelope` propagated to dependents.

### CI/CD & Workflow Improvements
- **#307** — Sync-only `workflow_dispatch` for release.yml main sync (OMN-17272): boolean `sync_only` input skips publishing steps, retries only idempotent half.
- **#1562** — Gate test-parallel/tests-integration behind non-draft PR state (OMN-16215): uses `!github.event.pull_request.draft`, adds `ready_for_review` trigger.
- **#3655** — Shard-plan partition proof moved to typecheck job (OMN-19684): reduces integration-guard runtime from 509s; typecheck at 99s.
- **#1208** — Backmerge main guard into dev promotion lane (OMN-12765): includes reverse-patch generation gate (OMN-11591).
- **#363** — CodeQL reusable workflow ref moved to omnibase_core (OMN-20074): updates required-checks.yaml, adds contract test.
- **#1713** — call-occ-autobind caller added to omnibase_core (OMN-14160): ports caller from omnibase_infra shape.
- **#314** — Bump omniclaude public-repo-hygiene-reusable.yml to a58fb5e.

### Omnimarket Node Features & Fixes
- **#3413** — Completed delegation sent to acceptance judge (OMN-20572, OMN-19915): `node_delegation_acceptance_judge_request_compute` subscribes to delegate-skill completed terminal.
- **#3274** — Savings file shape corrected (OMN-20304): migration renamed, relation inventory regenerated, repo contract added.
- **#3635** — `node_morning_ground_state_orchestrator` registered (OMN-20673): added to `onex.nodes` entry points, removed from EXPECTED_MISSING_ENTRY_POINTS.
- **#3051** — Lane container memory event projected into `lab_container_memory_window` (OMN-19961): fold handler + projection writer with upsert on conflict.
- **#3466** — Real redelivery tests moved to Golden Chain Suite (OMN-18887): DoD contract updated to `test_golden_chain_node_delegate_skill_orchestrator.py`.
- **#3710** — M4 landing configs from facts; idempotent enqueue (OMN-20866): omnibase_infra companion-exempt, queue repository, dry_run mode.
- **#2955** — Emit registry routes `hook.event`; redaction governs nested members by dotted name (OMN-19513): full-content capture topic, span-scrub class, session_content projection.
- **#3289** — Routing reducer eligibility mirrors dispatched credential path (OMN-17096): fixes `api_key_env` fallback vs `api_key_ref` resolution mismatch.
- **#3805** — Automation-liveness watchdog compute node (OMN-20806): verdicts, failure episodes, hysteresis, observer-loss folding, planted self-test.
- **#3161** — Delegate-skill terminal carries lane and session (OMN-19860): `caller_lane` and `session_id` declared on `ModelDelegateSkillResponse`.
- **#2841** — `no_escalation` declared on delegate-skill request (OMN-18931): passed only when true, requires backend_id pin.

### Core Infrastructure & Tooling
- **#966** — Gate 4: banned silent `except: pass` (OMN-10217): substrate_gates package with BaseGateCheck, GateViolation, allow annotations.
- **#1324** — Burn down 3 omniintelligence url-authority grandfathered reads (OMN-13561): baseline 215→212.
- **#1255** — UI contract primitives + EnumEmptyStateReason (OMN-13130): six frozen Pydantic models (Component, Action, DataBinding, Permission, etc.).
- **#279** — Official OmniNode brand `<picture>` README header (OMN-16663): 13 vendored assets, prefers-color-scheme banner.
